summary: The code and focused tests preserve morphology-neutral linking and technical-valid short tracks, and implement specimen-level sensitivity formulas. Acceptance remains conditional because the retained evidence does not include a clearly identified current-commit below-2-um sensitivity output demonstrating end-to-end count and missingness reconciliation.

tests/test_saturn_v571_dual_head.py:test_comparative_unet_primary_score_does_not_penalize_length_morphology verifies short and long morphology receive the same tuner score.
sperm_segmentation_saturnv5.7.1.py:5799 onward implements global assignment; comparative morphology-neutral mode zeroes length, width, and area assignment weights.
tests/test_saturn_v571_dual_head.py:test_short_terminal_observation_can_bridge_one_missing_plane verifies a short observation remains linkable and missing_slice_count is retained.
tests/test_saturn_v571_dual_head.py:test_bbox_overlap_cannot_bypass_absolute_centroid_distance verifies an adversarial false-link case is rejected.
sperm_segmentation_saturnv5.7.1.py:13612-13649 computes primary technical-valid count, below-2-um count/fraction, and sensitivity medians per sample using calibrated physical-length fields.
scripts/generate_specimen_sensitivity_artifact.py:38-101 computes technical exclusion, area-normalized, volume-normalized, and width-missingness metrics without dropping specimen rows.
tests/test_specimen_sensitivity_artifact.py:test_rows_keep_excluded_specimens_and_mark_denominators verifies count reconciliation, denominators, and missingness.

audits/evidence/v571_rc6_candidate/report/02_quality_control/data/specimen_sensitivity_artifact.json:2-20 declares specimen-level analysis, explicit formulas, and descriptive sensitivity interpretation.

audits/validation/v571_6f9e73b_validation.md:78-90 reports technical-valid counts and retained report consistency, but does not provide a separately identified below_2_um_specimen_sensitivity.csv artifact or current reviewed-commit hash for that output.

audits/evidence/v571_rc6_candidate/report/02_quality_control/data/specimen_sensitivity_artifact.json:4-9 retains 35 specimen rows with 2 included and 33 excluded/missing, but this artifact is the general technical-QC sensitivity ledger rather than explicit below-2-um sensitivity output.

findings.title: Current below-2-um sensitivity output is not retained or directly reconciled
findings.impact: The implementation computes the required specimen-level below-2-um sensitivity table, but the available retained evidence does not independently demonstrate that its primary counts, omitted-short counts, and morphometry fields reconcile to the reviewed commit's track summaries.
evidence: audits/evidence/v571_rc6_candidate/report/02_quality_control/data/specimen_sensitivity_artifact.json contains general technical-QC rows but no explicit below_2_um_count or sensitivity_count_without_below_2_um fields.
findings.recommendation: Retain a current-commit below_2_um_specimen_sensitivity.csv/JSON artifact and an independent reconciliation test asserting primary_count equals technical-valid track count and sensitivity_count equals the technical-valid subset with physical length at least 2 um.

limitations: Length below 2 um cannot distinguish genuine short nuclei from unresolved fragments.
The sensitivity implementation uses projection_z_extent_um as its threshold field; this must remain explicitly documented as the population-length definition.
recommended_follow_up: Generate and independently validate the explicit below-2-um specimen sensitivity artifact at commit 7a4c7d13a88f441e490b330ffe5206b418633c1e before changing the verdict to pass.
